meta.name: House and garden as surveyed
meta.grid: Site grid. Origin: the outer south-east corner of the rear outshot at ground level, by the back door. +X runs south, away from the back of the house; +Y runs east, towards the road. z = 0 is level 20.00 m on the measured survey.
meta.north_note: Grid north, as a direction in (X, Y). The back of the house faces 20 degrees west of south.
meta.source: Six phone clips (a pan from the lawn and five short walks) reconstructed with COLMAP: 719 frames, 310,000 points. Vertical from brick coursing. Scale, position and height datum from eight control points read off the measured building survey (1:50 plans, 1:100 elevations). Plot boundary and north from the 1:500 block plan. One frame through the attic window, oriented by the window frame, for the far side of the outbuilding.
meta.accuracy: House and shed: a few centimetres (measured survey). Patio and east garden, filmed on foot: about 0.1 to 0.2 m. South and west garden, filmed from one spot: checked against a second viewpoint and good to about half a metre along the line of sight, better across it. Outbuilding: front wall within 0.3 m, east wall and depth within 0.4 m, west and north walls inferred. Drive, front garden and the ground behind the outbuilding: not surveyed.

features.label: South wall (dark modern brick)
features.notes: Modern dark stretcher-bond brick with a red plinth, behind the big shrub and the bench. Its line is the plot boundary on the block plan, which agrees with the brick coursing seen in the footage (75 mm courses put it 8.9 m from the camera). The top is hidden by the shrubs: height 1.6 to 1.85 m. Its east end was outside the pan, so it stops where the footage stops.

features.label: South wall, west end (old stock brick)
features.notes: Yellow stock brick in Flemish bond with a coping: a 6 ft wall. Position and height triangulated from two clips (top of coping 1.76 m above datum, ground here about 0.08 m below it). Within about 0.3 m.

features.label: West wall (old red brick)
features.notes: Soft red brick, exposed for about 2 m behind the picnic table and ivy-covered either side. Triangulated from two clips (231 points, flat to 0.27 m). It runs about 1.2 m outside the boundary drawn on the 1:500 block plan, which is within that map's tolerance.

features.label: Ivy on the west wall
features.notes: Dense ivy standing about 2.1 m, from the exposed brick to the hazel.

features.label: Fence to the playing field
features.notes: Dark boarded fence seen between the hazel and the outbuilding. Only a glimpse in the footage: its line is the wall's line carried on, and its height is a guess.

features.label: Beech hedge along the road
features.notes: Clipped beech, 1.75 to 1.8 m tall. Its garden face is measured from a clip filmed walking along it: 9.0 m east of the grid origin beside the kitchen garden, 8.6 m further south. The road side is not seen, so its thickness (1.5 m) is assumed, and north of the kitchen garden its line is carried on by eye. A telegraph pole stands in it.

features.label: Gate posts between the house and the shed
features.notes: Glimpsed at the edge of the pan. Position within a metre or so.

features.label: The house
features.notes: From the measured building survey (1:50 plans, 1:100 elevations and section): main range 8.52 x 5.66 m, rear outshot 4.38 x 4.38 m under a catslide roof that comes down to 0.9 m, ridge 7.62 m, half-hipped at both ends, three chimneys, lean-to WC on the west side. Wall positions are good to a few centimetres. The east end of the rear wing is timber-framed with brick infill, and its black frame is drawn from the east elevation and the footage. The north (front) and west elevations are from the drawings only; window bars and joinery are indicative. The first floor has projecting oriel windows on the front and at the north end of the east wall, drawn here as flat openings.

features.label: Timber shed (mossy roof)
features.notes: Footprint 2.58 x 4.41 m from the measured survey; the gable seen in the footage lands within 12 cm of it. Eaves 1.46 m and ridge 2.38 m from the footage.

features.label: White outbuilding
features.notes: Roughcast walls, black fascia, green corrugated sheet roof: about 6.0 x 7.0 m. The front wall, its west corner, the window and the door are triangulated from two clips in the garden (rays meet within 5 cm). The east wall, with a second window, and the north end were then fixed from a clip filmed through the attic window, whose direction comes from the window frame itself: it puts the east wall 1.3 m beyond the shed and the building 7 m deep, good to about 0.4 m. The west and north walls have not been seen: they are drawn square to the others. The roof looks nearly flat and its fall is not established. The block plan draws a 5.0 x 6.7 m building: the same depth, but a metre narrower and 1 to 2 m further east.

features.label: Paved patio
features.notes: Old concrete flags in courses, about 0.47, 0.59 and 0.71 m (18, 24 and 28 in). The outer edge is 4.96 m long and 3.85 m from the low wall of the house. Two spot levels on the measured survey put it at 19.99 m.

features.label: Old apple tree
features.notes: Marked "Apple" on the measured survey: trunk 0.40 m across at the base, crown 4.9 m across centred 1.3 m north of the base, because the trunk leans hard towards the house. The first model had put it 0.44 m away from here using the footage alone. Height and branch pattern are indicative.

features.label: Willow (pollarded)
features.notes: Pollarded tree in front of the west wall, cut back hard: one limb sawn at about 4.4 m. Trunk about 0.6 m across. Species not confirmed. Position from the pan and one walking-clip sighting: within about a metre along the line from the middle of the lawn.

features.label: Hazel (multi-stem)
features.notes: Tall coppice in front of the ivy at the north end of the west wall; its base is hidden by the brush pile, so within about a metre.

features.label: Big old shrub with the hose
features.notes: Pale multi-stemmed shrub leaning out over the bench and tables, between the lawn and the south wall.

features.label: Small twisted tree
features.notes: Stands just in front of the outbuilding window.

features.label: Evergreen shrub
features.notes: At the east end of the south border.

features.label: Shrubs along the south wall
features.notes: Only just in frame. Shown as part of the border; treat as a placeholder.

features.label: Yellow-leaved coppice by the south wall
features.notes: Tall twiggy growth in front of the dark wall behind the log rounds. Species not identified.

features.label: Shrub clump in the east lawn
features.notes: An evergreen with glossy leaves and bare deciduous stems growing up through it, in a ring of bare soil: about 2 m across and 1.75 m tall. Seen from both sides.

features.label: Young bare-stemmed shrub
features.notes: A whippy young shrub or fruit bush in the lawn near the goal. A second one stands close by.

features.label: Lantern on a post
features.notes: A black lantern on a slim post beside the shrub clump, its head 1.4 m above the grass, with a pale tube on the post below it: a garden light, or a bird feeder with a baffle. Triangulated from two frames (rays meet within 2 cm).

features.label: Grey-leaved shrub
features.notes: Large silvery evergreen at the edge of the lawn; the drive is behind it.

features.label: Yellow-leaved shrub
features.notes: Seen from a distance at the north end of the east garden.

features.label: Conifers in the north-east corner
features.notes: Dark evergreens 8 to 10 m tall, seen over the vegetable plot. Position within a couple of metres.

features.label: Sage bed under the apple tree
features.notes: Overgrown bed around the pale tree: a big sage, low evergreens, twiggy stems, foxglove rosettes. Plant positions are approximate.

features.label: Sedum bed
features.notes: The bed beside the viewpoint. The pan started and ended here so only its edges were filmed; the far side of it is assumed.

features.label: Vegetable plot
features.notes: Dug over in ridges running east to west, with a few seedlings. The brick edging along its hedge side is measured. Its north and west edges were out of frame: they are drawn where earlier footage, from across the lawn, put them.

features.label: Bed by the house
features.notes: Bare soil with seedlings, pots and seed trays, starting 0.8 m out from the east wall of the house. Its south and east edges are measured; its north end was out of frame.

features.label: Brick edging by the hedge
features.notes: Old red bricks laid end to end between the vegetable plot and the strip of ivy and leaf litter under the hedge. Read off the footage with the survey grid drawn on the ground: within about 0.15 m. It probably carries on north of where the clip starts.

features.label: Brick edging by the lawn
features.notes: A straight line of bricks where the kitchen garden meets the lawn, running from beside the stump towards the hedge.

features.label: Boards on the ground
features.notes: Two long boards lying in the grass between the compost bin and the hedge.

features.label: Cane wigwam
features.notes: Bean canes tied in a wigwam, standing over the brick edging: about 2.2 m tall. Position within about 0.4 m.

features.label: Bean poles against the house
features.notes: A bundle of hazel poles stood against the east wall, reaching 2 m up it.

features.label: Wooden mushroom
features.notes: A carved garden ornament in the strip under the hedge.

features.label: Picnic table
features.notes: A long one: 2.1 m. Its two ends were sighted from both clips.

features.label: Split log stack
features.notes: Position from points seen in both clips.

features.label: Football
features.notes: Sighted from both clips: it lies at the foot of the stock wall.

features.label: Garden bench
features.notes: Size checked against the footage with the calibrated camera.

features.label: Folding table
features.notes: Top 0.66 m above the grass, measured.

features.label: Pots along the house wall
features.notes: A dozen or so assorted pots and a trough stand along the low wall; individual pots are indicative.

features.label: Large terracotta pot
features.notes: Stands on the grass just off the west edge of the patio. Sighted from two clips.

features.label: Green glazed pot with grass
features.notes: At the south-east corner of the patio. Triangulated from three frames: the rays meet within 3 cm.

features.label: Big tree stump
features.notes: A very large stump: about 1.4 m across the cut and 0.6 m high, with root flares spreading to a little over 2 m. The earlier model, which had only seen it from across the garden, had it 1.7 m too far north. It is now fixed from close up: the glass ball that sits on it is triangulated to under a centimetre.

features.label: Glass ball
features.notes: A blue-green glass ball in the stone trough. Sighted from two frames 66 degrees apart: the rays pass within 7 mm of each other.

features.label: Green compost bin
features.notes: A small cone-shaped bin among long grass, its lid 0.76 m above datum. Triangulated from two frames (rays meet within a centimetre). The earlier model had it 1.1 m away.

features.label: Blue ride-on toy
features.notes: Lying on the lawn in the later clips, where the first clips showed something blue that was taken for a tarp. It will have moved since.

features.label: Blue tarp
features.notes: Seen once from across the garden; the later clips do not look that way.

features.label: Pop-up goal
features.notes: By the hedge, its mouth towards the lawn. The top of the arch is triangulated; which way it faces is judged from how narrow it looks from the north.

features.label: Neighbour's house (west)
features.notes: Brick house seen over the west wall behind the pollarded tree. Footprint from the block plan (its nearest corner is 4.3 m beyond the wall); heights from the footage. Massing only.

features.label: Neighbour's house (south)
features.notes: Footprint from the block plan, simplified to a box. Not seen in the footage: heights are a guess.

features.label: Telegraph pole
features.notes: Stands in the hedge line; a cable runs from it to the east gable of the house. Position within about a metre.

features.label: Road sign
features.notes: On the verge behind the hedge. Position within about a metre.

features.notes: Stands in for the trees beyond the boundary so the skyline reads correctly; individual trees are not surveyed.

features.label: Plot boundary (from the 1:500 block plan)
features.notes: About 1,035 square metres. Map accuracy is about a metre: the west wall measured from the footage runs 1.2 m outside this line, the south wall sits on it.

features.label: Outbuilding as drawn on the block plan
features.notes: 5.0 x 6.7 m on the map. The footage agrees with its depth and its north end, but puts the building 1 to 2 m further west and makes it 6.0 m wide. Tree cover over the west end may be why the map draws it short.

features.label: Grid origin
features.notes: Outer south-east corner of the rear outshot at ground level. X runs south from here, Y runs east. To do 6, three tape or laser measurements that would tighten the far garden: the outer edge of the patio (the model says 4.96 m), the apple tree trunk to the exposed brick of the west wall (15.2 m), and the south-west corner of the outshot to the west front corner of the outbuilding (14.1 m).

features.label: Inspection chamber IC1
features.notes: Round cover, level 20.06 m; invert 19.53 m (pipe 0.53 m down). From the measured survey.

features.label: Inspection chamber IC2
features.notes: Square cover, level 20.02 m; invert 19.67 m. From the measured survey.

features.label: Drain between the chambers (assumed line)
features.notes: The inverts fall 0.14 m from IC2 to IC1, so the flow is towards the lawn. The route is drawn straight between the covers; where it goes from IC1 is not known.

features.label: Not yet surveyed: front garden and the front of the house
features.notes: No footage here. The front and west elevations of the house come from the drawings; the ground is a blank.

features.label: Glimpsed only: the yard between house, shed and outbuilding
features.notes: Seen once, steeply from the attic window: rough grass and ivy, bins against the house wall, a boarded fence on the shed side, a gravel path past the chimney. Nothing north or west of the outbuilding has been filmed.

features.label: Not yet surveyed: drive and south-east corner
features.notes: Only glimpsed over the shrubs (a parked car, gravel). Entrance, gates and the boundary here are not modelled.

features.label: To film 1: South and west garden, on foot
features.notes: This part was filmed from one spot, so its distances are the weakest in the model. Two slow loops: one hugging the walls and looking in, one down the middle looking out at the walls. Start and finish on the patio.

features.label: To film 2: Round the outbuilding and the shed
features.notes: Every side of both that you can reach, with the corners and the ground line in shot, including the passage between the house and the shed and whatever is behind them. The outbuilding now measures about 6.0 x 7.0 m from the garden and the attic window: this would confirm it and fill in what is behind.

features.label: To film 3: Front garden and the front of the house
features.notes: A slow loop of the front garden with the camera on the house, then the same loop with your back to the house, looking out. Keep the ground in frame.

features.label: To film 4: Drive, entrance and south-east corner
features.notes: From the road entrance walk in along the drive, then along the inside of the south wall as far as the bench.

features.label: To film 5: Roof and chimneys
features.notes: Still photos rather than video: each roof slope and each chimney, zoomed in, from the far corners of the garden and from the road.

features.label: To film 7: Inside the outbuilding
features.notes: Stand in each corner in turn and film the opposite corner from floor to ceiling. Then walk out through the open door with the camera running, so inside and outside join up.

features.label: To film 8: Inside the shed
features.notes: The same as the outbuilding: each corner, floor to ceiling, then out through the open door in one go.

features.label: To film 9: Inside the house: rooms not yet filmed
features.notes: Both floors are in the model from the floor plans: open the house with the Ground floor and First floor buttons. Each room card says whether it has been filmed. For the rest, one clip per room: stand in a corner and turn slowly for 20 to 30 seconds, lights on, curtains open.
